---
title: ObserveChildren
description: Instance children observation utility for tracking child added/removed events with automatic cleanup.
---

ObserveChildren captures each child of a given instance and provides a cleanup callback when children are removed. Handles both initial children and future additions.

## Usage

```luau
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local observeChildren = require(ReplicatedStorage.Vendor.ObserveChildren)

local disconnect = observeChildren(workspace.Enemies, function(child)
    print('Enemy added:', child.Name)
    setupEnemy(child)

    return function()
        print('Enemy removed:', child.Name)
        cleanupEnemy(child)
    end
end)

-- Later: stop observing
-- disconnect()
```

## API Reference

### `observeChildren<T>(instance: Instance, callback: Callback<T>): () -> ()`

Creates an observer that captures each child of the given instance.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `instance` | `Instance` | The parent instance to observe |
| `callback` | `(child: T) -> (() -> ())?` | Called for each child, optionally returns cleanup function |

Returns a disconnect function that stops observing and cleans up all children.

## Callback Behavior

The callback receives each child and may return an optional cleanup function:

```luau
observeChildren(folder, function(child)
    -- Called immediately for existing children
    -- Called later when new children are added
    processChild(child)

    return function()
        -- Optional: called when child is removed
        -- or when observer is disconnected
        cleanupChild(child)
    end
end)
```

## Example: Dynamic UI List

```luau
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local observeChildren = require(ReplicatedStorage.Vendor.ObserveChildren)
local Janitor = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Janitor)

local function setupInventoryList(container: ScrollingFrame)
    local bucket = Janitor.new()

    local disconnect = observeChildren(container, function(itemFrame: Frame)
        local itemBucket = Janitor.new()

        -- Set up hover effects
        local hoverConn = itemFrame.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            itemFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
        end)
        itemBucket:Add(hoverConn)

        local leaveConn = itemFrame.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            itemFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100)
        end)
        itemBucket:Add(leaveConn)

        bucket:Add(itemBucket, 'Destroy')

        return function()
            -- Cleanup when item frame is removed
            itemBucket:Destroy()
        end
    end)

    bucket:Add(disconnect)
    return bucket
end
```

## Example: Enemy Spawner Tracking

```luau
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local observeChildren = require(ReplicatedStorage.Vendor.ObserveChildren)

local activeEnemies = {}

local disconnect = observeChildren(workspace.Enemies, function(enemy: Model)
    local id = enemy:GetAttribute('EnemyId')
    activeEnemies[id] = enemy

    return function()
        activeEnemies[id] = nil
    end
end)
```

## Cleanup Guarantees

- Cleanup functions are called when a child is removed
- Cleanup functions are called when the observer is disconnected
- Cleanup functions are called even if child is destroyed before setup completes
- Initial children are processed via `task.defer` to avoid blocking
